- Jumping Pads added
- Changes to weapons & bosses
- Removed console, switch to panel-style for cheatcodes
- UI changes
- Created the base for future localization
- Enemies voiced by me (Trunka) insulting player
- Recoil patterns in 'Devilated' difficulty or higher
- Lots of changes/ fixes

notes.title: Update V0.8.14 & The MIX Next 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/aea6bf1c46d47a1f0219c62a769a710aa753e509.jpg[/img]
[h2]Hi folks,
Devilated is joining The MIX (The Media Indie Exchange) this time! Here is the new trailer:[/h2]

[previewyoutube=L_CD1igzzRg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]After discussing, we have decided to reduce the price of Devilated to $20 and bring joy to a wider audience.

And to make up for this change, the soundtrack from Sigurd Jøhnk-Jensen ($7 including mp3, lossless and some extras) is given to everyone who purchased the game before this update.[/h3]

[h3]These changes affect the overall gameplay from the start, especially the weapon balancing. 
The inventory could need some reorganization as the slot count is increased.
If your saved game is affected by the new flow much, you can always revert to the older V0.8.13 version. Try keeping at it for a while first.[/h3]

[list]
[*][b]Back to 6 specific weapon slots[/b]
now the player has to choose a good weapon for each type instead of putting all samey machine guns in every slot - while still being able to equip 2 handguns early on. This is like going back to the root with a hybrid solution to the 'Can't equip both the revolver and another handgun at the same time' and the 'Free slots make weapons feel repetitive' problems.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/7fcad7335934c87c0ba7ffc6ea07c7f2260306ce.jpg[/img]
[*][b]Auto switch to another weapon[/b] when the current weapon is out of ammo/ durability
[*]Right click a weapon in the inventory to use [b]Quick Equip[/b] (even if that weapon slot is occupied)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/b3d32d0429cd80edb3f46e75456c13e77fdba7c8.jpg[/img]
[*][b]The melee weapon can be charged[/b] now (R button)

	+ Charging makes you [b]invulnerable[/b], increases the damage up to 4x, increases the movement speed but it drains the weapon's durability. 

	+ Overcharging results in nearby enemies stunned & pushed away but it resets the charging bar & leaves you vulnerable to attacks for a bit.

	+ Every attack with a melee weapon pushes enemies away.

	+ Wielding a melee weapon charges less dashing energy (6 times dashing instead of 3)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/f94e30f3b4b8a66266d6b667e1207eaf86e4065a.gif[/img]

[*]The ammo capacity for machine guns/ heavy guns are reduced. Combined with auto-switching, this makes you use every weapon available flawlessly.
[*][b]Inventory slot count is increased[/b] to 64 instead of 49
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/63845a584798b797a72b14f83326616c8822d5c7.jpg[/img]
[*]The ammo/durability upgrade is removed, the HP upgrade count is increased.
[h3]These are now designed to use every weapon in your equipment (flowing with auto-switching) until most of them are out of durability (which could be quickly replaced with other weapons in a bigger inventory by using the Quick-Equip button) [/h3]

[*]A proper [b]Tutorial section[/b] is added at the start
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/8e757fe095656b6026d7aee7ab8537a0b723b799.gif[/img]
[*][b]Enemies & Bosses hit feedback[/b] is tweaked.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/c29edf8422b86e3782d35f443693a33deffc0f35.gif[/img]
[*][b]Blessing Statue recovers all weapons' 100% durability & ammo[/b], and defeating a boss also does the same thing now.
[*]Enemy spawning in NG+ modes is reverted to the normal one with a high enemy count & not randomized anymore. (it shows progression and is more fun. but a wreck for your machine)
[*]The weapon repairing price is changed based on the current level now (cheaper at start)
[*][b]Brighter UI with RE4/5 health indicator style[/b]. All the gauges around the crosshair are removed - now Bullet-time/ Dashing/ Reloading bars are separated and only shown at an appropriate time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/b69037f12f586bf6864f65e5940be3adec966229.jpg[/img]
[*][b]Some enemies' damage is reduced[/b], including most of the high-damage shooters, fishes, 1-hit kill molten-sword dude, and toxic spitter dude. (I call them Horn and Mutant Dwarf)
[*]Diving adds more Stylish points
[*][b]Dog in town[/b] doing nothing. You can choke it (can be called petting but whatever)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/9ce7939ab955e3e21a5576ae0036461c73e861ae.jpg[/img]
[*]Enemy hit color shows the correct one (orange with HP resource enemy, blue with Ammo resource enemy) instead of having all blue.
[*]Some enemies & all the bosses have [b]Emissive parts[/b] on them now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/0ee324d7e92d64e5775e613ce67d53fcbcbaee70.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/1490a93cb59e9a8cc2bba236b85d7f711565ea4b.gif[/img]
[*]The [b]Death Screen is simplified[/b]: A panel is automatically shown when you are dead with related options. You can simply press E without doing anything else to reload the last saved file after death.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/8ab7b6c3921861538993265bfd515e718da74004.png[/img]
[*][b]Saving Timestamp[/b] is added, with the latest saved file marked.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/23361cbcc494754bf21a6dc03ea0d649faec0a3c.png[/img]
[*][b]Loading a saved game makes you invulnerable to attacks[/b] for a few seconds.
[*][b]Increasing the Stylish bar will increase the attack speed[/b] now. Be offended.
[*][b]Incoming arrows are changed[/b]: besides small arrows indicating nearby enemies (useful to detect the melee ones), there are mid-sized arrows (normal attacks) and big arrows (high-damage attacks).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/a35de850d561b8436414ef0bb38c373eb532fdfe.jpg[/img]
[*][b]Enemy pre-attack[/b] is tweaked
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/aaf72e22d0c71a9a4227cecdc6265ec43ea604f0.gif[/img]
[*]Shooters rotate towards the player more slowly.
[*]Limbo cursor item is completely back. Looks weird, but well, it works.
[*]Picking up gibs is removed to avoid accidentally doing that while using Diving.
[*]Player colliding radius is smaller.
[*]Secrets (except for the text easter eggs) all contain grenade items.
[*]All the heavy guns are non-burst type now.
[*]You can [b]wipe off the crab/ trap[/b] by repeatedly pressing F now.
[*]The loading screen is tweaked.
[*] Rocket launchers/ Cannons are tweaked to be stronger.
[*] Heavy enemy attacks are more clear in visual and audio.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/22c18a9919c35b6803eab4b9d9bc63d28651435f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Thanks to Neon Doctrine QA team - Froggy & Dylan Wei

and the community: Dotoo, Mr. NoName, GMStarson, Matheo, Kuro, CrudD and everyone 

Especially Walkinon_bodies for the long Twitch streaming sessions with not-frequently-seen real-time reactions.[/h3]

[h3]Cheers,
Trunks[/h3]

notes.title: Neon Doctrine cooperation, The Indie House, and Update V0.8.12
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/9a54f8bd7561ff64af2adc6947f4071d9905dd98.png[/img]

[h3]Hey folks, Trunks here. The publisher is Neon Doctrine, they have an amazing list of games you can check out, and they are very nice guys. Neon Doctrine is bringing Devilated to The Indie House event this year. [/h3]
[previewyoutube=Hrfw2XlMNzw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]And the full reveal event:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=bi25oCVIE7M;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Below are the changes since the last May update.[/h3] If you bought in the Realms Deep event, chances are you've seen parts of them as I've been pushing them out gradually. If you are with the old builds and haven't finished, it's recommended to restart as the design is changed (password "LowkeyVibeMode" for older versions).

[h3]Push-forward combat[/h3] 
with in-battle colored resources. Potion system, potion shop and gem shop are removed. Ammo is reduced, forcing switching weapons constantly. Orange corpse heals 30 HP, blue corpse heals 50% all weapons' ammo, white corpse gives 1 grenade. Thanks to [b]Demetroid[/b] for the suggestion of incorporating the push-forward design more closely in Devilated. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/ca120c7b16a61714055d8f29fa310a4129c3ffe2.gif[/img]

[h3]'Durability' is added[/h3]
Previously, 'weapon disappearing' forced constant weapon switching. Now broken weapons could be kept in the inventory to be recharged at Bless Point (once per level). [b]Merchant now recharges durability[/b] instead of providing ammo (costly)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/c4283c2d513751f4fc8c862d70a2f9185c7178cf.gif[/img]

[h3]Picking a corpse up by standing near it[/h3]
instead of having to point at it. Combine Diving with Use key.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/19750cad3c0ae2c90fba1bb8bc05ca463a25da23.gif[/img]

[h3]Main loop[/h3]
+ Low on HP/Ammo: Explode corpse/ Use Diving
		+ Low on Durability: Keep in the inventory to recharge at Bless Point/ Replace with new weapons (from merchant/ crates)
		+ Out of ammo: Switch to other weapons to passively regain that weapon's ammo via blue enemies/ Replace with new weapons

[h3]Compass with next point marker[/h3] Hard to get lost now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/06bbddf965c38f9839acc797205e2585951ff828.gif[/img]

[h3]Kill text is added[/h3] 
Each kill has an absurd text flying up with a color indicating the hp/ammo/grenade resource. [b]The default brightness is increased and the contrast is lowered[/b]. Easier to see enemies killed even in the dark now.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/29d7bbaee3b2c534eff84a2525f3a8ae84a7f3fe.gif[/img]

[h3]Enemies are more stupid[/h3]
(run horizontally sometimes instead of only charging at player)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/40438b13c4889cb35f8ac1269b716c3bfb2f8256.gif[/img]

[h3]Bosses' vulnerable parts are highlighted with outlines.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/d7b08442ddd5941fb104e338bb70b3b67793b3b2.gif[/img]

[h3]Consumable orange & blue fires[/h3] in Boss fights for hp & ammo that can regenerate later.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/945a734ccb09e1035cd7556908a9c2955b6ce715.gif[/img]

[h3]Unlock more variations of weapons, enemies,... earlier in the game[/h3]
The start of the game becomes difficult sooner.

[h3]Bullet-time is limited[/h3]
just enough to fight in later levels. [b]Incoming Enemy Arrows/ HP/ Ammo/ Dash/ BulletTime bars[/b] added around the crosshair: Easily monitored instead of looking at the screen corners.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/eaff09497af852765254948b0cd79d2d3a3dd5c5.gif[/img]

[h3]Defeating boss rewards[/h3] Spawning 4 random items & Recharging 100% HP + Durability + Ammo for all weapons.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/79e590416d10b87e8e3986104a15fe84d27b016c.gif[/img]

[h3]Enemies in Slaughter II and Slaughter III (NG+) are randomized[/h3]
After completing the game in Slaughter I, the final enemy variation is maintained onto the next NG+ with unpredictability & increased enemy number instead of first levels' grunt enemies again.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/d8c9bae2652e47b32114023c466454943b1f7fca.gif[/img]

[h3]Show damage stats and labels[/h3]
(explosive/ energetic...) on weapons except for Staffs. Except for the Machine guns which are more consistent, damage is a rough estimation as weapons are varied.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/8715219aef48746be749199ac1a7861d5a6bdff0.jpg[/img]

[h3]"Retro" as the default color[/h3]
instead of "Raw". The game is more cohesive in style.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/8273caa05e092dc4543b1d19def8f7de070e5108.jpg[/img]

[h3]Default Warrior difficulty is harder[/h3]
(+50%). 5 difficulty levels instead of 10.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/c9c7d8dacc6edec87d7b9f3cc2fc2a4fcc6923c7.png[/img]

- [b]Meat shield[/b]: more effective (blocking 65%) at the cost of its durability
- [b]Maximum gold[/b] = 20k.
- [b]Stylish bar[/b] is now a speed multiplier
- [b]Encampment portals[/b] are scattered around the map. Some buttons are removed
- [b]Fewer total equipment slots & inventory slots[/b]
- [b]Movement is smoother & less restricted.[/b]
- [b]The game is slowed down a bit[/b]
- [b]Teleporting point is hidden[/b] in the Encampment area until the very last level.
- Added a [b]setting to not increase music volume[/b] during combat
- [b]Focus mode: Zooming in amount reduced[/b], mouse looking sensitivity reduced.
- Loading screen is simplified.
- [b]Full changelog:[/b] https://steamcommunity.com/app/570950/discussions/0/3110267314130087922/

[b]Working with Neon Doctrine, from now on I'll keep the most updated experimental version at "FutureMan" branch[/b]

[h3]And as I've usually said, it is always easiest to manage the expectations :) 

Thanks to Ty - In The Keep, Demetroid, Matheo, Adria Carrasco, Nikolay Korneev, Choo Choo, Dotoo and Shang-Pao for the feedback.[/h3]

[h3]Cheers![/h3]

notes.title: V0.8.8-V0.8.10
notes.content:
[h3][b]Folks, these are the changes made from v0.8.8 to v0.8.10[/b][/h3]

[h3]Headbangging music[/h3] by Sigurd Jøhnk-Jensen
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=raoXNaObjds]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=raoXNaObjds[/url]
[previewyoutube=raoXNaObjds;full][/previewyoutube]
You can buy the soundtrack at:
Bandcamp - https://sigurdjj.bandcamp.com/album/devilated-official-video-game-soundtrack
Spotify - https://open.spotify.com/album/23eL1QDmUtHZw4kQ5jFYFN?si=u8ec6Wo-QVuX1jXHq5NI3w
Itunes/Apple Music - https://music.apple.com/dk/album/devilated/1566592107?l=da

[h3]Music visualizer[/h3] is added to the Stylish bar
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/803355ab5b79ab19f8b05c88689668640b838cc8.gif[/img]

- Berserk mode is removed. (Now the default is 2X)

- Being dead when jumping outside of gaming area (instead of being teleported to starting position)

[h3]Map system[/h3] with fog of war is added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/b70ba797c2a7417f6920e0044b0e0d6d1e063da3.gif[/img]

[h3]Checkpoint saving system[/h3] is added (Saving shrines scattered across the map)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/5e4aba250084a927933e63084188712897e05b75.gif[/img]

- Enemies detecting/showing range & view distance are increased.

- Ability groups are now unlocked in order instead of abilities being freely unlocked.

[h3]Freely equip[/h3] any weapon to any slot. Equipping several Rocket Launchers at once? possible.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/e38cd7a00f5b0868c9d6a5a9a7b4a2a73fad2496.gif[/img]

[h3]Lighting design[/h3] is changed, volumetric lighting is added
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/d1ed210091d2fe4860e6e6ee07b9e5b9a743e113.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/be908f66fb862ec0aa805109b232b07fd4a20bb0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/7e222bf3c2b65d771cd581c62ed04ea61995fdaa.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/f1d61e6a2e9882374cf48494d36abc2bf5d95d27.jpg[/img]

- Some areas are redesigned and trimmed

- All the puzzles are removed.

- Added options to reduce screen shaking.

- Added a toggle for blood splatters image effect.

[h3]Corpse outlines[/h3] are shown when being near, helping us to pick them up easier.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/d7e13ed08ce38c285aa485089bfd6cb6e44ff85a.gif[/img]

- Default shortcuts are changed. Press Reset Controls to retrieve the new control map. (Map: Tab; Potion: Z,X,C; Smoke:M; Spin: J). *Note: If you have played the game before, go to Controls/Restore Defaults to apply these new hotkey changes.

- More apparent player being damaged feedback

- Going back to Encampment ability is unlocked at start

[h3]Endless mode Dual Silver Shutgun[/h3] as the default and only weapon. There is only 1 difficulty in Endless mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/96de124b53a4340e08ef925817499c9fa15875d7.gif[/img]
[h3]Weapons are not breakable[/h3] anymore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/992d0c7d1f17e8b36bd148ae16a773c0ecac5b39.gif[/img]

- If a weapon is equipped in the inventory, automatically change the current weapon to this new weapon.

- Time is even slower now when opening the inventory.

[h3]Blessing statue[/h3] in the pre-boss area giving out potions and health regeneration instead of having to solve puzzles.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/15ca9eb2a58763441dfbeb7873543c2a87d169c6.gif[/img]

- All weapons recharge price + potion prices are now depending on levels.

- A number of different bug fixes and changes (See Changelog.txt in the game folder)

[h3]Temporary Slots[/h3] to temporarily store items and make organizing items easier
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32367439/5481f00215ea6e06a9bbb3d6b0b8bb5e2bf9d3a0.gif[/img]

[h3]Thanks to the community for the helpful feedback, especially Zach, UnderTheMayo, Daemonnnn, Daniracula and Mazerrackam.[/h3]

[h2]NOW GET IN THE GAME![/h2]

notes.title: V0.8.7 Hotfix
notes.content:
- Shovel can now be dropped.
- Stylish meter: Switching weapon will increase added amount for a short while. Amount after each hit is decreased. Gold amount multiplier is higher(0.2 to 0.3).
- Default color is changed (Not brown-tinted anymore. You can access old tinting with Settings/Color/Yellow). 
- Several Cannons/ Rocket launchers are now beefier
- Music is always played even when the player is not in battle (at a smaller volume)
- "Retro" Unfiltered tex on and no Anti-aliasing as the default options

Full Changelog: https://steamcommunity.com/app/570950/discussions/0/3110267314130087922/
